description: CRISPR QC brings real-time quality control into gene-editing workflows, turning a slow, opaque 'black box' process into one that is measurable, predictable, and dramatically faster. Its SaaS platform and chip make CRISPR safe and scalable for therapeutic applications.

MDisrupt is the expert marketplace for healthcare innovation, connecting healthtech, medtech, diagnostics, and life-science companies with vetted clinical, regulatory, reimbursement, and commercialization experts. With 2,500+ experts and partners including the American Heart Association, it helps innovators assemble fractional teams and bring evidence-based products to market faster.

Mu Medical (formerly Nanodropper) is building an ophthalmic platform spanning medication delivery, adherence, and disease monitoring. Its flagship Nanodropper helps patients cut eye-drop waste and prescription costs, with 150k+ units sold and collaborations including Mayo Clinic and Gerresheimer as it expands into drug delivery and ocular diagnostics.

NEXT Life Sciences is developing Plan A, a long-acting, non-hormonal, fully reversible male contraceptive advancing through clinical development. The platform is expanding into additional reproductive-health programs, including endometriosis, targeting some of the largest and most underserved markets in healthcare.

Nicolette is a patient-empowerment tool for parents of babies in the NICU, built around its flagship NicoBoard. The platform streamlines communication, coordinates care, and reduces administrative burden for neonatal and pediatric teams, expanding into cardiovascular intensive care and discharge automation across leading children's hospitals.

Ohai.ai is the AI-enabled operating system for modern families, reducing the invisible mental load of caregiving and household coordination. Founded by Care.com founder Sheila Lirio Marcelo, it unifies school communications, calendars, appointments, activities, and caregiving into a single intelligent platform, building a new coordination layer for one of society's most overlooked challenges.

description: Pillar Biome turns routine bloodwork into precise, actionable nutrition plans, making food-as-medicine practical without complex testing or behavior-change barriers. By bringing precision nutrition and gut health within reach, it targets some of the most widespread and preventable chronic conditions of our time.

Raydiant Oximetry is developing next-generation technologies to make childbirth safer for mothers and babies. Its flagship Lumerah is the world's first non-invasive fetal pulse oximeter, directly measuring fetal oxygen to reduce unnecessary emergency C-sections, with Daisy targeting postpartum hemorrhage. Built by pioneers of pulse oximetry, with a 2025 GE Healthcare partnership.

Sober Sidekick is transforming addiction recovery with a peer-powered platform built on a simple truth: addiction thrives in isolation. Nearly one million members get real-time support, and a patented empathy algorithm trained on one of the largest sobriety datasets identifies relapse risk before a crisis hits. Aligned with health plans and Medicaid, it proves recovery should never be monetized through relapse.

Talamus Health is a mobile-first healthcare operating system built for emerging markets, connecting patients, providers, and pharmacies into a unified system. By closing multiple systemic gaps at once, it is laying the foundation for more accessible, affordable care at scale across Africa.

Tenzr Health is building the infrastructure layer for physical rehabilitation that continues beyond the clinic and into the home. Its AI copilot, sensor-based tracking, and gamified experiences turn static, low-adherence home exercise plans into adaptive care journeys, letting therapists treat more patients with better engagement and outcomes.

The Gleamery is building the first modern consumer brand in preventative and cosmetic dental care. Its spa-like, retail-based experience in West Hollywood handles cleaning, whitening, and straightening without the insurance complexity, opaque pricing, or anxiety of traditional dentistry, with revenue, EBITDA, and unit economics running ahead of plan.

TheraB Medical developed SnugLit, a wearable phototherapy solution that lets newborns receive jaundice treatment while remaining in their caregiver's arms, preserving bonding without compromising care. A conservative QALY analysis found roughly $13,000 of societal health benefit per dollar invested. Acquired by Natus Medical.

TheRxAssistant is a pharmaceutical patient-access and engagement platform that guides patients from diagnosis to treatment across a compliant omnichannel AI experience spanning web, SMS, voice, and chat. Purpose-built for manufacturers, it helps patients find providers, understand coverage, access copay assistance, and stay on therapy, improving adoption, persistence, and outcomes.

Trellis Health is a personal health-data operating system for women and families, turning fragmented medical records into a longitudinal, patient-owned profile. By combining record aggregation, personalized insights, and AI-powered guidance across pregnancy, postpartum, and beyond, Trellis helps patients navigate care while enabling providers to deliver more coordinated treatment.

Welby Health delivers technology-enabled chronic care management for underserved populations, combining remote patient monitoring, care coordination, and patient engagement. Purpose-built for Federally Qualified Health Centers and value-based care organizations, it extends care teams beyond the office visit, driving 5x YoY growth at 30%+ gross margins.

ZIORA is developing a first-in-class fertility platform that improves egg quality and ovarian health by targeting the mitochondrial dysfunction and cellular aging behind reproductive decline. Rather than managing the consequences of reproductive aging, it works to improve the biological quality of eggs themselves, improving IVF outcomes with early commercial traction in international markets.
